Branch Operations Manager

Duties:
  • Supervise and support the routine operations of branches to ascertain adherence to proper procedures
  • Engage in sales activities for promoting consumer banking products to prospective clients
Requirements:
  • Degree holder or equivalent qualification at HKQF level 5.
  • Minimum 3 years’ branch operations experience and at supervisory level.
  • Passes in Securities and Futures Intermediaries Examination is a must. (Qualified under SFO for handling Regulated Activities Types 1, 4). Passed in MPF & Insurance Intermediaries Examinations are preferable.
  • Detail-minded, good communication skills and can work well in a team.
  • Candidate with less experience will be considered as Assistant Branch Operations Manager.


Email: hs_recruit_1@hk.bankcomm.com

Wealth Planning Manager


Duties:
  • Provide full range of wealth management services to a designated portfolio of high-net-worth customer
  • Expand the existing client base by exploring potential customers in the market

Requirements:
  • Degree holder or equivalent qualification at HKQF level 5, with minimum 3 years' experience in handling investment portfolio of affluent customers
  • Passes in MPF, Insurance, Securities and Futures Intermediaries Examinations are required. (Qualified under SFO for handling Regulated Activities Types 1 & 4)
  • Professional qualification of ARWP is an advantage
  • Candidate with less experience will be considered as Deputy Wealth Planning Manager

Financial Services Manager


Duties:

  • Promote full-range of retail banking products and services to achieve sales targets
  • Identify customers’ needs and match their needs with appropriate products and services including account opening, credit card, mortgage, personal loan and insurance and MPF products
  • Maintain good relationship with both existing and new clients
Requirements:

  • Degree holder or above or equivalent qualification at HKQF level 5, with minimum 3 years’ experience in promoting retail banking products
  • Passes in Insurance, Securities and Futures Intermediaries Examinations are required. (Qualified under SFO for handling Regulated Activities Types 1 & 4)
  • Pass in the MPF Intermediaries Qualifying Examination (Optional)
  • Professional qualification of ARWP is an advantage
  • Candidates with less experience will be considered as Deputy Financial Services Manager
